g.text: When bird and background disagree, CLIP follows the bird 65% of the time; the
fitted boundary leans 0.31 logits towards 'waterbird', so landbirds need more
1200 sampled birds (clean masks), margins clipped to ±7. Additive fit on the water score: s(orig) =
0.67·s(bird) + 0.65·s(background) + 0.31 [0.22, 0.41], R² = 0.83. Above its dashed line a bird is classified
